methods.label: Find the distance traveled per hour
methods.explanation: At 45 kilometers per hour, the distance traveled in 4 hours is 180 kilometers.
methods.levelReason: Division finds the hourly distance, and multiplication gives the four-hour distance, using Grade 4 arithmetic and quantity relationships.

methods.label: Add two equal time intervals
methods.explanation:
Four hours consists of two \(2\)-hour intervals. At the same speed, each interval covers \(90\) kilometers, so the total distance is
\[
90+90=180\text{ kilometers}.
\]
methods.levelReason: Repeating the given two-hour journey uses equal time intervals and mental addition, with no more advanced prerequisites than the unit-speed method.
